arStrings.szText: Each enemy hit by {c_important}Teleport{/c} increases the damage by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x1|]{/c} and reduces the Cooldown by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|2|]{/c} of the next Cast. Becoming {c_important}Injured{/c} will {c_important}Teleport{/c} you to a random location.
